title: Noise operator on a monomial
statement: For every nonnegative integer $n$, real $\rho$, and subset $S\subseteq[n]$, the noise operator on the $n$-dimensional sign cube sends the monomial $x\mapsto\prod_{i\in S}x_i$ to $\rho^{|S|}$ times that monomial.
